This city has a real charm to it and everyone needs to visit it once in their life. #oran #algeria #travelalgeria #africa #solotravel

From a beach in California, the conversation came back to Algeria. 🇩🇿🌊 She came as a visitor. What stayed with her wasn’t just the landscapes, the food or the history. It was the people. That’s the thing about Algeria: some of what makes it unforgettable is difficult to explain until you’ve experienced it yourself. So let’s ask the people who know it best: What’s ONE thing about Algeria you wish the rest of the world understood? 🇩🇿 Tell us below — especially if you’re Algerian or part of the diaspora. And if there’s someone in your DMs who only knows the Algeria they’ve seen from afar, send them this. Some places impress you. Algeria stays with you. Not travel. A return. #Algeria #الجزائر #Algerie #TravelStories #Wanderlust

After weeks in a strict, conservative country, one city felt like a different world 🇩🇿 Oran is open, artistic and free. Women work as doctors, lawyers, in government, and I saw women serving in a restaurant without a hijab for the first time on the trip. A port city that chose to be free. 👇 #oran #algeria #progressive #northafrica #travel #mediterranean
